title: The battlefield changes when the Guru is with you
summary: Let mercy steady the breath before fear writes the day. Keep this close: Carry this with you: fear thins when shelter becomes personal again.
takeaway: Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru turns life's hard field into a place of victory.
source.lifeApplication: When fear makes life feel combative, ask for the Guru's nearness before reacting.
